signals.quote: We're scaling clinics fast and our referral coordination is cracking.
Your platform came recommended by the ops lead at Lakeside Medical.
Do you have time next week?
Tuesday the 24th, 10am pacific?
Feel free to bring whoever owns day-to-day coordination
We're scaling from four clinics to eleven this year. Our intake and referral coordination breaks a little more with each new site. I need it fixed before the fall openings.
Day to day, that's me. Every clinic has its own intake spreadsheet and referrals get lost between them weekly.
What I care about is timeline and whether this survives contact with healthcare data rules.
I'd want to pilot with our two busiest clinics first. If it works there it works anywhere.
Set up a full demo with Malik, our engineering director. If he's comfortable, we pilot.
how does patient data flow through your system? I need to know what's stored, where, and encrypted how.
EHR integration is the other big one - we're on Athena.
Can my coordinators see referral status across all clinics without switching views? That's the daily pain.
I like what I'm seeing. What does the pilot look like commercially?
My comfort depends on the technical review.
nothing today scared me, which is rare.
Let's do the pilot. Tara owns rollout, Malik owns the technical gate.
pilot agreement attached: four weeks, your two busiest clinics, flat fee credited on rollout
Tara cc'd for kickoff scheduling
Signed and returned
Tara will take scheduling from here
following up on the docs you promised at the demo
Is PHI ever processed outside your VPC?
What's your RTO if the sync service goes down mid-day?
Does the Athena integration poll or use their event API?
I don't have a contact on your side
On your questions: 1) No, PHI never leaves the VPC. 2) RTO is one hour, historically much faster. 3) Event API with polling fallback.
happy to set up a session with our SE Sam for anything deeper
Answers work for now.
I'll hold the deeper questions for the formal review.
can we add our Riverside clinic coordinators as viewers this week?
They're curious
Curiosity from non-pilot clinics is the best sign there is
week 1 numbers: 214 referrals routed, zero lost
one hiccup - the friday batch from clinic 2 came in slow, took about 40 min to clear
that was a queue backup on our side during a deploy window. Fixed
I'll flag your account for the off-peak deploy group going forward
noted that you caught and explained that before I had to ask. good sign
Zero lost referrals across both pilot clinics. Normally we'd have dropped five or six by now. My coordinators are asking when the other clinics get it.
Before full rollout, this goes through our formal security review. It's a real process, three-ish weeks, and I can't shortcut it.
Assuming security clears, I want full rollout before the fall clinic openings. Jordan, get us a full proposal in parallel so the review isn't blocking paper.
coordinators from 3 non-pilot clinics have now asked me when they get access
told them after security review
questionnaire goes out to jordan this week
an eleven-clinic commitment at this number is board-visible for us
is there someone on your leadership side who'd be my counterpart for the commercial conversation?
Better to have that relationship before we're negotiating redlines
I'll set up an intro this coming week
security questionnaire sent to your email just now. also need to schedule that live architecture review, my team wants 90 minutes with your data layer people
who should I coordinate with?
For the architecture review let me coordinate on my side and come back with names and times - likely early next week.
still zero lost referrals
my coordinators built a small shrine to the unified queue
